x: Eddie Paterson, off 290 yds., was second, with Whenman in third place. The Weight handicap saw a good muster of field event men, and the winner was D.
Brian Trower finished third in the Portsmouth A.C. open 5 miles road handicap race, with a start of 3 min. 10 secs., and has also been running with the R.A.F., Sopley. E.
Sec. has been honoured with Vice-Presidency of the E.C.C.U. E.T. Paterson writes from Barnstaple to say that he has gained 2nd place in the R.A.F.
E. Paterson, running for the "B" Team, caused a surprise by beaing the 2nd Belgrave man to finish and far ahead of many of our "A" Team members.
John Burr paddled to victory ahead of Eddie Paterson. Support by sprinters and middle distance men alike in the field events kept the result of the match in the balance right up to the end.
There was a terrific tussle for the placings, G. Davidson (150 yds) putting in a well judged finish to beat E.
